## What this changes

_One sentence on the user-visible effect. Not the implementation._

## Why

_What problem or use case this addresses. Link the issue if there is one._

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour (or the bug that was fixed)
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally on Node 18, 20, or 22
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under an `Unreleased` section
- [ ] Breaking change? Noted in the description with migration guidance

## Scope

- [ ] Grammar syntax change
- [ ] Compiler pass
- [ ] Runtime / generated parser behaviour
- [ ] CLI or API surface
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / internal only
